run_mpi_optimizer: run the DeepMimic optimizer in parallel using mpiexec with a specified number of workers
run_with_num_workers: run the mpi_run script with a custom number of workers via the num_workers argument
review_main: review the main function that parses CLI args and launches mpiexec to run DeepMimic_Optimizer.py
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional CLI arguments beyond num_workers
test_subprocess_call: test the subprocess call that executes the mpiexec command with the constructed argument string
